title: Dream Mentor
start: Talk to the fallen man inside the small cave in the Lunar Isle Mine.

items.t: 3 different kinds of food: 6 of 1 type and 7 of 2 others for a total of 20 pieces.

Purple sweets, roast potatoes, mince pies, yule logs, and mint cakes cannot be used; stackable foods, such as holy biscuits, will be counted as a single piece of food; cake can be used in all 3 pieces.
An easy way to acquire the food items is to use the lodestone teleport to Port Sarim, which brings you right next to the Wydin's Food Store, and then lodestone teleport right back to Lunar Isle.
Cabbages, onions, and raw potatoes can be found within Rellekka. To use fewer backpack space, you can fill the vegetables into empty sacks, or alternatively bring uncut pineapples.

recommended.t: Food (bring the highest-healing food for your level)
A ring of recoil can be useful, especially for players low on food
Being on the Lunar spellbook and having runes for the NPC Contact spell

kills.t: The following must be defeated in one trip, without prayers:

rewards.t: 15000 Combat XP lamp in one of: Strength, Ranged, Magic, Constitution, or Defence
9 new spells added to the Lunar spellbook:
Access to the 'Random' option on NPC Contact

steps.t: Enter the mine in the north-east area of Lunar Isle.
Crawl-through the cave entrance (quest minimap icon).
Talk to the fallen man (close the interface when it appears). [Chat: Accept]
Starting with one of your 7 item foods, feed him 4 food while cycling through your different foods.

sub.t: Starting with a food item of which you brought 7 items will ensure you do not run out of variety.

steps.t: Talk to him again. [Chat: 1 Just don't worry. › 1 Of course.]
Feed him 4 more food as before.
Talk to repeatedly to raise his spirits:

sub.t: Of the four chat options, choose the one that appears on the table below.
Select the response according to the table.
Repeat until a short cutscene plays and he sits up.

steps.t: Feed him 6 more food.
Talk to him and raise his spirit as before until he stands up.
Exit the cave and climb up the ladder.

sub.t: Or just use the Lunar Isle lodestone

steps.t: Talk to 'Bird's-Eye' Jack in the bank. [Chat: 2 Cyrisus in the mine] You will need 1 free inventory space for Cyrisus's chest.
Select the equipment he needs. The equipment is usually, but not always, dependent on your highest combat stats (Magic, Ranged, Melee):

sub.t: Melee: Dragon helm, Abyssal whip, Ahrim's robe top, Ahrim's robe skirt, Ranger boots
Ranged: Splitbark Helm, Karil's top, Torag's platelegs, Adamant boots, Magic shortbow
Magic: Robin Hood hat, Dragon Chainbody, Black dragonhide chaps, Infinity boots, Ancient staff

steps.t: You can use the NPC Contact spell to ensure you have the right equipment.
Return and talk to Cyrisus (Fallen Man) for a cutscene. [Chat: 1 Talk about the Armament]
Right-click "inspect" and fill the remaining stats until he tells you that he is ok (if not already).
Talk to the Oneiromancer at the astral altar (most south-eastern part of the Lunar Isle) for a dream vial (herb). [Chat: 2 Cyrisus]
Change your spellbook as necessary if you wish to use magic in the final fight.
Use an astral rune on an anvil (there's one on Lunar Isle in a small building to the south), then grind the shards. Add it to the potion.
Prepare for 4 fights (below level 100). Prayers and emergency teleports won't work. Neither will familiars.
Light the Ceremonial Brazier in the long hall building, near the lodestone.
Talk to Cyrisus (dismiss any followers before). [Chat: 1 Yes, let's go!]

sub.t: Do not click away of the chat or you will be teleported out

steps.t: During the fight, you can leave at any time by using the pedestal.

sub.t: Kill The Everlasting (can safespot by the pedestal)
Kill The Untouchable (can safespot by the pedestal)

steps.t: Return to the Oneiromancer. [Chat: 2 Cyrisus]
Quest complete!
